# iximiuz-labs_playgrounds (Data Source)

Lists iximiuz Labs playgrounds with an optional filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iximiuz-labs_playgrounds" "all" {
  filter = "all"
}

output "playground_names" {
  value = [for pg in data.iximiuz-labs_playgrounds.all.playgrounds : pg.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Optional filter string to narrow the list of playgrounds.

### Read-Only

- `playgrounds` (Attributes List) The list of playgrounds matching the filter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--playgrounds))

<a id="nestedatt--playgrounds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `playgrounds`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) A short description of the playground.
- `name` (String) The unique name of the playground.
- `page_url` (String) Web UI URL for the playground.
- `title` (String) The display title of the playground.
